rows.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
rows.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

rows.name: Bank credit growth (y/y)
rows.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
rows.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

rows.name: Aggregate deposits – scheduled commercial banks
rows.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
rows.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

rows.name: Aggregate deposits growth (y/y)
rows.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
rows.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

rows.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Scheduled commercial banks, y/y growth rates, percentage points. A wider gap means credit is growing faster than deposits; it is not a cash shortfall. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.

rows.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth, 3-month average
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Average of the latest three monthly gaps; months with any gap missing are left out. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.

rows.name: Incremental credit–deposit ratio, financial year to date
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Change in bank credit since end-March per ₹100 change in deposits since end-March. Not shown while deposits have grown by less than 0.5% of the end-March stock (or fallen), usually April and May. Compare with the same month of the previous financial year.
